notes: §1985:VII.2.6.2 prints [ ORGANIZATION IS ] SEQUENTIAL, with ORGANIZATION and SEQUENTIAL underlined and IS not, so the clause is SEQUENTIAL alone or ORGANIZATION [IS] SEQUENTIAL. organizationClause is (ORGANIZATION IS?)? organizationType and organizationType's sequential alternative is RECORD? SEQUENTIAL; BindFileControl stores MapOrganization's FileOrganization.Sequential for it at every edition, and a file control entry with no clause keeps the same default (§1985:VII.2.6.3 GR3). The 1985 edition reaches the format through VisitOrganizationClause, which refuses the two words 2023 adds before SEQUENTIAL: LINE and the written-out RECORD are each COBOL0900 at --std 85 (accepted at 2023). ScreenClauseRepetition refuses a second ORGANIZATION clause (COBOL2423). Probed at 85: ORGANIZATION IS SEQUENTIAL, ORGANIZATION SEQUENTIAL, a bare SEQUENTIAL, the clause before ASSIGN, a bare SEQUENTIAL beside ACCESS SEQUENTIAL in either order and an entry with no clause all compile and run as a sequential file; IS SEQUENTIAL without ORGANIZATION (COBOL1970), ORGANIZATION IS with no type, ORGANIZATION ARE SEQUENTIAL and ORGANIZATION IS BINARY SEQUENTIAL (COBOL5506), LINE SEQUENTIAL and RECORD SEQUENTIAL with or without ORGANIZATION IS (COBOL0900), and the clause written twice (COBOL2423) are refused. The witness declares four files with the three spellings (the bare one also beside ACCESS MODE IS SEQUENTIAL), writes each and reads it back in the order written.

next.reason: §1985:VII.2.6.2 gives a sequential file only '[ORGANIZATION IS] SEQUENTIAL' (RELATIVE and INDEXED were already 1985 formats of their own modules). §2023:12.4.5.10.2 still accepts the bare form, RECORD being an optional word, and §2023:12.4.5.10.3 GR3 gives it the 1985 meaning ('The RECORD SEQUENTIAL phrase specifies that the file organization is record sequential'), so a 1985 clause means the same; but the format now also offers LINE SEQUENTIAL, a new organization (§2023:12.4.5.10.3 GR2, 'Line sequential organization is a permanent logical file structure'), which the 1985 format refuses. The format is wider: CHANGED. The meaning of sequential organization is the record of 1985 GR2, not of this format. §2023:12.4.5.1 'Format 3 (sequential)' restates the clause in line with the same LINE and RECORD alternatives.
